content.content:
1. License, per prerequisite: apply this once against each id in depends_on — no element
   of the dependent contradicts that prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element —
   name the element and the prerequisite it contradicts; the dependent must survive both
   legs, item 2's rule included.
2. The added commitment, stated and additive: the dependent must carry the rule that an
   inverse of a change-level operation is the revert of the entries the marker kept, and
   that a change's content is never re-derived to take one. Fail if that rule is absent or
   left open — the inverse's source unstated; stated only as reverting the operation
   without saying what supplies the inverse; or stated so that the inverse may come from
   the subject's present content, from recomputing what the operation did, or from the
   node's text rather than from the entries a marker kept — and name both what is missing
   and the clause that leaves it open. Fail in the other direction if one prerequisite
   named in depends_on already states the whole rule: the edge then licenses nothing new —
   name the prerequisite and the clause.
3. Nothing unrecorded decided: fail if applying items 1-2 needs a rule the dependent and
   its named prerequisites do not record — the marker's entry format, what a kind's inverse
   journal holds, how content is captured when an operation is recorded, or how an entry is
   reverted — and name the missing rule instead of deciding it.
content.rationale: Both endpoints are inline requirement sentences, so the cell is the matrix default: the natural-to-natural license gate, applied once per prerequisite. S3-op-revert uses D8a for the inverse's scope — a whole operation, never an operation's internals — and D15b for its mechanism — the revert of the entries a marker kept — so the check runs the license against both legs and then asks whether the rule the decision adds is present and is genuinely new; a restatement of either prerequisite would make the edge vacuous. No wording, file or symbol is named, so a rewrite that still takes its inverse from the marker's entries leaves the check unchanged. It is applied to the recorded text of prsoxsuo and qwqwqtuq only: capability D8b (txqmnvup) also speaks to how the inverse is fixed and is not on this edge, so the check may not borrow its clauses to license the added rule.
